description: Governor's Secretariat - Fifth Supplyment Financial Statement, 2019 of Sabaragamuwa Province
categorisation: This gazette content focuses exclusively on structural and administrative changes to the financial management of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It grants permission for expenditure disbursement, amends budget estimates, and specifies financial allocations across various provincial departments and ministries. While it mentions institutional structures and program responsibilities, it does not name any specific individuals or provide detailed portfolio assignments to named persons. The content deals purely with government organizational and financial administration without personnel changes.
